name: zigcss-language-server
description: Experimental Language Server Protocol client for the ZigCSS recovery prototype

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension launches a local ZigCSS executable. Trust the workspace and configure a trusted binary before activation.

virtualWorkspaces.description: ZigCSS currently synchronizes file-backed CSS documents through a local process.

zigcss.languageServerPath.description: Absolute path or bare command name for a trusted ZigCSS binary. Empty searches an extension-local bin directory, then absolute PATH entries; it never executes a workspace-relative path.

zigcss.languageServerArgs.description: Arguments passed directly to the ZigCSS language server process.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run compile && node --test test/*.test.cjs
